correctness.rationale: Independent stdlib replay confirms every headline number. Fresh sieve to 5e6 gives exactly 546 (0,2,6,8) quadruplets (first 5, last 4997381). Full consecutive-gap scan gives unique maximum 56910 at (3741161,3798071); second largest 56580; full 18-record chain matches DRAFT exactly. All 8 witness endpoints verified prime by sieve plus independent trial division and MR(2,7,61). Kourbatov values at x=q2 recomputed: a=12690.52, T0=72353.63, R0=-1.2169 (b=1 -> -0.217, b=2 -> +0.783 by R0+b). Dual binning methods (interval-inclusion and isqrt) both give K=478 occupied of n=1..2235; exhaustive empty-run scan gives unique maximum E=22 at n=187..208, i.e. [34969,43681] empty, bracketed by [34841] and [43781]. HL sums recomputed: 538.45 total, 461.40 occupied. No inference error; finite exhaustive computation correctly distinguished from analytic proof.

originality.rationale: Isolated maximal-gap value and witness are PRIOR ART and not new: OEIS A113404 lists record quadruplet gaps 6,90,630,...,56580,56910,... (56910 present since Kourbatov 2012) and A229907 lists preceding initial prime 3741161 (with A113403 the endpoint). Kourbatov arXiv:1301.2242 proposes the estimator a*log(x/a)-b*a and arXiv:1309.4053 tabulates record gaps to 1e15. None of these publishes the combined Legendre-square occupancy census to 5e6 (K=478, maximal empty run E=22 with witness [34969,43681], HL expected-vs-observed 538.45/461.40) or per-record Kourbatov standardized residuals. A007530/Nicely/Luhn give bare quadruplet positions only; Oliveira e Silva gives single-prime gaps only; A192870 gives only conjectural maximal empty-square thresholds (0,122,3113,719377,...) with no census. K,E,witness,residuals,HL sums require HL/estimator computation and exhaustive binning and are not transcribed from any source. Combination is substantively new even though the gap value alone is knowable.

value.rationale: Strongest headline (complete Legendre-square occupancy census for the unique minimal-diameter admissible quadruplet (0,2,6,8) over the natural pre-committed scope of 2235 intervals to 5e6: K=478, unique maximal empty run E=22 at [34969,43681], HL expected 538.45 total / 461.40 occupied vs observed 546/478, plus exact maximal-gap witness 56910 at (3741161,3798071) with Kourbatov residual R0=-1.2169) is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object, motivated before computation by the Hardy-Littlewood k-tuple conjecture, Kourbatov maximal-gap estimator, and Legendre-type constellation program. Values were not known or mechanically implied; a future gap-modelling or Legendre-type study can reuse the precise K/E/witness/residual. Narrow exact datum is independently retrievable per standard; honest finite census with stated modest-bound limits, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration.

decisive_checks: Ran inputs/artifacts/verify.py: VERIFY_OK (quads=546, Gmax=56910, a=12690.52, T0=72353.63, R0=-1.2169, K=478, E=22, HL 538.45/461.40).
Independent re-sieve (separate code path) reproduced 546 quadruplets, unique max (56910,3741161,3798071), top-5 gaps, and full 18-record chain exactly as DRAFT.
Trial-division primality proof of all 8 witness numbers; MR(2,7,61) agreement.

Dual Legendre binning (inclusive-interval scan vs isqrt) both K=478; exhaustive run scan: unique max (22,187,208); confirmed empty [34969,43681] and brackets [34841],[43781]; confirmed no quad above 4999696 and last-quad 4997381 in n=2235 interval.

Prior-art diff: confirmed 56910 and q1=3741161 present in A113404/A229907 (so isolated gap not novel) while K/E/witness/residuals/HL sums absent from all checked sources.
residual_risks: H4=4.151180863656573 taken as published Hardy-Littlewood quadruplet constant without re-derivation from prime-constant product; small constant error would shift a/T0/R0 and HL sums at the ~0.1% level.
Certification is exhaustive finite computation (sieve + scan), not an analytic theorem; correctness rests on code and machine arithmetic, mitigated by two agreeing implementations.
5e6 bound is modest and maximal gap undershoots T0 (R0 negative); no significance/Gumbel claim is made — census is the citable component.
Interval-endpoint convention [n^2,(n+1)^2] vs isqrt binning coincide here because no square is prime; explicitly verified.
